title: The Saint's Tongue
text: In a reliquary of black glass sits a tongue, pink and wet, that has not stopped praying in four hundred years. You can hear it if you lean close: a small, endless murmur. The glass is fogged on the inside from its breath, though it has no lungs.

options.label: The most devout kisses the glass, hoping the saint's prayer passes into them.

outcomes.text: For days after, their hands are warm and wounds close beneath them. The murmur never quite leaves their ears.
The tongue falls silent, and so does theirs. Their voice will return in time, though not before the next fight.

options.label: Let it pray on. It has been at it longer than any of you have lived.

outcomes.text: As you leave, its prayer grows a little louder. None of you can tell what it is praying for.
